beats.text: They don't see it yet. But I do.
God, I just want to build something real. Show me where to start.
A bird on a wire carrying thousands of volts. And it's fine.
Electricity flows only when there's a voltage difference. A push from high to low.
One wire, so both feet share one voltage. No difference, no current.
Touch two wires, or the ground, and it's a different story.
Two bare wires touching. Exactly what the bird avoids.
